user_input: Evidence kaise save karun taake baad me court me kaam aaye?
reply_text: other roman_urdu 1. har message ka screenshot le kar date aur time ka record karein. 2. agar possible ho to chat logs ko export kar lein aur pdf ya text file ke roop mein save karein. 3. saare evidence ko ek se zyada jagah (e.g., external hard drive, cloud storage) mein backup karein. 4. har tarah ka original data delete na karein, kyonki court mein authenticity zaroori hai. 5. agar platform support kare to 'save as pdf' feature use karein taki format maintain rahe. 6. kisi trusted adult ya lawyer ko dikha kar unki review ke liye deejain. yeh tool sirf support ke liye hai, legal advice ya emergency service nahi.
